faq.label: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers or search specific questions.

q1.question: How do I connect Kickot chatbot to my Kick channel?
q1.answer: Simply click on "Log in via Kick", authorize your account, and activate Kickot bot in your Dashboard. The bot will join your chat automatically.

q2.question: Is KickALL free to use?
q2.answer: Yes! The basic Kickot chatbot with commands and moderation is completely free forever. Pro and Elite plans are available for advanced tools and unlimited customization.

q3.question: How do I add alerts and widgets to OBS or Streamlabs?
q3.answer: In your Dashboard, generate a unique Browser Source URL and paste it as a new Browser source in OBS / Streamlabs. Settings changes apply live without restarting.

q4.question: Are my data and Kick account safe?
q4.answer: Absolutely. We use official Kick OAuth 2.0 authentication with S256 PKCE encryption standard. We never have access to your passwords or private keys.

q5.question: Can I create custom commands and alerts?
q5.answer: Yes! Through the Dashboard you can create up to 50 commands on the free plan, while on others you can create unlimited. Just visit the commands panel within the Dashboard!

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: 2026 Data protection standards fully compliant with EU GDPR, EU Data Act, NIS2 Directive, EU AI Act, and global privacy frameworks.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy governs how KickALL (operated by Milan Web Portal, based in Belgrade, Republic of Serbia; hereinafter: "KickALL", "we", "us", "our") collects, uses, processes, stores, and protects personal data obtained from users of our website, applications, and streaming modules (Kickot, Kickaj, Kickov, Kickan). KickALL acts as a Data Controller under the General Data Protection Regulation (EU GDPR 2016/679) and applicable privacy laws.
privacy.basesIntro: We process personal data only when a valid lawful basis exists:
privacy.basis1: Contractual Performance (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR): Processing is strictly required to provide chat automation, custom commands, giveaway draws, and OBS overlays under our Terms of Service.
privacy.basis2: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR): For Kick OAuth 2.0 PKCE authentication, bot channel connectivity, and optional feature customization.
privacy.basis3: Legitimate Interests (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR): To protect system integrity, prevent bot-raids, spam, DDoS attacks, and optimize real-time streaming performance.
privacy.basis4: Legal Obligations (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR): For tax, accounting, and regulatory records related to subscriptions and referral disbursements.
privacy.dataIntro: We strictly adhere to data minimization principles:
privacy.data1: Kick Platform Data (OAuth 2.0): User ID, username / slug, profile image URL (avatar), and chatroom ID obtained through official Kick OAuth flow. KickALL never accesses or stores your Kick password.
privacy.data2: Account & Authentication: Email address and securely salted/hashed passwords via Supabase Auth (using bcrypt/Argon2 algorithms).
privacy.data3: Stream Configuration & Analytics: Custom commands, automated timers, moderation blacklist words, watchtime statistics, and giveaway draw logs.
privacy.data4: Referral & Payout Data: Referral codes, referral statistics, and payout addresses (PayPal email, IBAN, or crypto address) explicitly submitted for withdrawal requests.
privacy.data5: Technical & Telemetry Logs: IP addresses (transiently in memory for rate-limiting and Cloudflare defense), browser user-agent, and access timestamps.
privacy.paddleIntro: All subscriptions and paid plans (PRO, ELITE) on KickALL are processed via our authorized Merchant of Record partner — Paddle (Paddle.com Market Ltd / Paddle Payments Ltd).
privacy.paddle1: KickALL NEVER collects, views, or stores your credit/debit card numbers, CVV codes, or full billing bank details.
privacy.paddle2: Transactions occur within Paddle's PCI-DSS Level 1 certified environment.
privacy.paddle3: KickALL receives only anonymized subscription tokens, transaction identifiers, status updates, and renewal dates necessary to activate plan features.
privacy.purpose1: Delivering reliable, real-time Kick chat bot connectivity and automated responses.
privacy.purpose2: Rendering dynamic OBS overlays (Kickov), giveaway visualizers (Kickaj), and viewer analytics (Kickan).
privacy.purpose3: Preventing platform abuse, mitigating cyberattacks, and enforcing security policies.
privacy.cookiesIntro: KickALL utilizes minimal browser storage (localStorage / sessionStorage) and necessary cookies:
privacy.cookie1: Essential Storage: Session tokens and OAuth state necessary to maintain authenticated dashboard sessions.
privacy.cookie2: User Preferences: Selected language (SR / EN) and interface theme settings.
privacy.cookie3: Traffic Analytics: Aggregated and anonymized data (Google Analytics GA4) used to measure server latency and reliability.
privacy.sharingIntro: We never sell, rent, or trade your personal data. Data is shared strictly with verified technical sub-processors:
privacy.sharing1: Kick.com API: Facilitating chat messaging, channel events, and stream status checks.
privacy.sharing2: Supabase Inc. (AWS Frankfurt, EU): Encrypted cloud database for configuration storage.
privacy.sharing3: Paddle: Merchant of Record and subscription payment processor.
privacy.sharing4: Cloudflare Inc.: CDN caching, SSL encryption, and DDoS defense.
privacy.transferText: User data is primarily hosted within the European Economic Area (EEA - Frankfurt, Germany). Where sub-processors operate nodes in other jurisdictions, transfers are safeguarded under European Commission Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and Data Privacy Framework standards.
privacy.retention1: Active Accounts: Data is stored for as long as your account remains active.
privacy.retention2: Deletion on Request: Personal data is permanently purged within 30 days of a valid account deletion request.
privacy.retention3: Security Logs: Telemetry and firewall logs are retained for up to 90 days for audit and security investigations.
privacy.retention4: Financial Invoices: Retained as mandated by tax and statutory auditing requirements.
privacy.rightsIntro: Under GDPR and data protection laws, you possess the following rights:
privacy.right1: Right to Access: Request a comprehensive export of all personal data held about you.
privacy.right2: Right to Rectification: Update inaccurate or outdated profile details directly.
privacy.right3: Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten"): Request permanent removal of your account and associated data.
privacy.right4: Right to Portability: Receive your stream configurations in a standard machine-readable format (JSON).
privacy.right5: Right to Lodge a Complaint: File a dispute with your national Data Protection Authority (DPA) or relevant supervisory body.
privacy.minorsText: KickALL is not directed toward individuals under the age of 16 (or 13 where local law allows). We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. If discovered, such data will be immediately expunged.
privacy.incidentsText: We enforce strict security controls (TLS 1.3 encryption, cryptographic hashing, Content Security Policies). In the event of a data breach impacting your rights, we will notify affected users and authorities within 72 hours as mandated by law.
privacy.contactText: For any privacy inquiries, data subject access requests (DSAR), or data deletion, reach out directly:
privacy.contactAddress: Data Controller: Milan Web Portal / KickALL, Belgrade, Republic of Serbia
privacy.footer: By utilizing the KickALL platform, you acknowledge and agree to this Privacy Policy.
privacy.section14: 14. EU AI Act & Automation Transparency (Regulation EU 2024/1689)
privacy.aiText: In compliance with the 2026 EU Artificial Intelligence Act, KickALL clearly discloses its automated systems: Kickot bot and companion tools operate as minimal-risk automation/AI utilities. Our systems never perform subliminal manipulation, biometric categorization, or autonomous legal decision-making without human-in-the-loop oversight. Stream chat participants are clearly informed when interacting with automated bot features.
privacy.section15: 15. Digital Services Act (DSA - Regulation EU 2022/2065) & Single Point of Contact
privacy.dsaText: As an intermediary digital service provider, KickALL complies with EU DSA obligations. We maintain a designated Single Point of Contact for users and European authorities to report illegal content, bot abuse, or intellectual property infringements at: contact@milanwebportal.com. Inquiries are audited within 24-48 hours with transparent dispute escalation.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.subtitle: 2026 Refund and consumer rights policy adhering to EU Consumer Rights Directive, PCI-DSS v4.0, and Paddle MoR standards.
refund.intro: All purchases on KickALL (PRO and ELITE plans) are facilitated by our authorized Merchant of Record partner — Paddle (Paddle.com Market Ltd / Paddle Payments Ltd). This Refund Policy aligns with Paddle's Global Buyer Terms, EU Consumer Rights Directive (2011/83/EU), and international SaaS consumer protection standards.
refund.fourteenDaysText: As a consumer of our SaaS services, you are entitled to a 14-day statutory right of withdrawal starting from the initial transaction date. If you are not completely satisfied with our streaming tools within the first 14 days, you may request a 100% full refund with zero penalties.
refund.eligibleIntro: Refunds are processed and approved without hassle in the following scenarios:
refund.eligible1: Duplicate billing or charge errors: Inadvertent double charges or incorrect invoice calculations.
refund.eligible2: Technical activation failure: Payment went through successfully, but plan features were not provisioned due to server issues.
refund.eligible3: Substantial service downtime: Verified core service outage exceeding 48 consecutive hours where our technical staff could not remediate the fault.
refund.eligible4: Requests within 14 days: Any valid request submitted within the first 14 days of subscription inception.
refund.nonEligibleIntro: Refunds cannot be granted under the following circumstances:
refund.nonEligible1: Requests initiated after the expiration of the 14-day statutory window for the current billing cycle.
refund.nonEligible2: Accounts suspended or terminated due to verified violations of our Acceptable Use Policy (e.g., bot raids, chat spam, illegal exploitation).
refund.nonEligible3: External sanctions or bans imposed on your channel by Kick.com unrelated to software defects.
refund.processIntro: Initiating a refund request is straightforward:
refund.step1: 1. Email our support: Send a message to contact@milanwebportal.com with subject "Refund Request - [Your Kick Username]".
refund.step2: 2. Include transaction details: Provide your account email address and your Paddle Order ID / Invoice number from the receipt email.
refund.step3: 3. Paddle Buyer Portal: Alternatively, you may manage transactions and initiate refund inquiries directly via paddle.net.
refund.timelines1: Support Response Time: Our support team reviews and acknowledges all inquiries within 24 to 48 business hours.
refund.timelines2: Disbursement: Once approved, Paddle automatically credits the original payment method (Credit Card, PayPal, Apple Pay). Funds typically reflect on your bank statement within 3 to 10 business days.
refund.disputesText: If you notice an unrecognized charge or billing discrepancy, please contact our support team prior to filing a bank chargeback dispute. We resolve legitimate issues immediately, whereas formal bank chargebacks cause unnecessary delays and potential payment gateway blacklisting.
refund.contactText: For any billing, invoice, or refund questions, we are here to assist:
refund.footer: KickALL operates with complete integrity, placing user trust and customer satisfaction at the forefront.
